summary: Media details freshness is hardened on main with NetworkFirst plus Apollo normalized-cache watch(), so newly opened details prefer current network data and retained detail collectors can receive fresher cache updates. The original episode 9/10 device reproduction is still pending, so the issue remains current rather than resolved.

facts.value: The same anime was reported with stale episode/next-airing data through a normal entry path and correct data when opened through Calendar. Calendar does not pass episode state into MediaDetails, it navigates with the same media ID route.
NavActionManager.toMediaDetails(id) creates only Route.MediaDetails(id). Navigator appends non-top-level routes to the currently selected top-level back stack.

NavigationState creates a separate NavBackStack for every top-level route, decorates every stack with a ViewModelStore NavEntry decorator, and explicitly retains state even when a top-level route is not currently in use.

MediaDetailsViewModel starts getMediaDetails() from init. MediaDetailsView obtains the ViewModel from the NavEntry-scoped Koin ViewModelStore and there is no general visibility/resume network reload path for the details query.

Merged PR #20 changes MediaRepository.getMediaDetails() to FetchPolicy.NetworkFirst plus Apollo normalized-cache watch(). New detail loads prefer current AniList data with cache fallback, while retained collectors can receive published normalized-cache updates without polling or navigation recreation.

Two freshness mechanisms are proven to have existed: a detail query path without an explicit freshness override and retained per-top-level MediaDetails ViewModel state. Both are now hardened by the merged NetworkFirst plus cache-watch implementation, but the physical reproduction needed to prove the original reported symptom is fixed remains missing.

PR #20 combined head fa52940514f4829221fe31aca3f75e3e5310dc44 passed Android CI run 32979821681 and Temporary Performance APK run 32979821731. Artifact 9611240387 belongs to that exact head. The PR was squash-merged to main as 8a2289ca75a4a66b6ae2e97303ee2d3f2b8be1e8.

Ready PR #17 was closed as superseded by merged PR #20. Draft PR #16 received the same superseded provenance comment; its close mutation was blocked by the connector, so no false closed-state claim is made.

constraints: Do not describe retained ViewModel state as the sole proven root cause until a reproducible test or physical run distinguishes it from the former Apollo freshness path.
Do not claim the original episode 9/10 reproduction is physically fixed until the real-device comparison is performed.
Do not disable Apollo caching globally.
Do not delete or collapse the separate top-level back stacks merely to force MediaDetails recreation.
Keep this issue scoped to freshness of AniList MediaDetails state; it does not establish guarantees for unrelated external availability sources.
